name: India News Summarizer
notes: Phase 6/7: Collect → normalize → AI → format → publish. Variables: GEMINI_API_KEY, PUBLISH_API_KEY ($vars). Keep inactive until Phase 8. TZ Asia/Kolkata.

meta.description: Hourly India news summarizer — format canonical JSON and publish to Railway API (Phase 7 retries)

nodes.name: Schedule Trigger
nodes.notes: Every hour at minute 0. Uses workflow timezone Asia/Kolkata. Keep workflow inactive until Phase 8.

nodes.name: Collect All Sources
nodes.notes: Fetch each enabled RSS/HTML source via helpers.httpRequest (isolated). Caps maxArticlesPerSource.

nodes.name: Normalize & Dedupe
nodes.notes: Trim/decode, canonicalize URLs, Asia/Kolkata timestamps, exact+near dedupe, maxArticlesTotal cap, corpus stats + guard flags.

nodes.name: IF Articles Exist
nodes.notes: True → AI categorize/summarize. False → empty-run guard (no LLM, no publish).

nodes.name: AI Categorize & Summarize
nodes.notes: Stage A+B via gemini-3.5-flash-lite. Rate limits: 15 RPM (~4.2s gap), 250K TPM, 500 RPD, max 16 req/run. Needs $vars.GEMINI_API_KEY (or $vars.AI_MOCK=true).

nodes.name: IF Briefing Ready
nodes.notes: True → format + publish. False → AI failed guard (no publish overwrite).

nodes.name: Format Briefing JSON
nodes.notes: Build schemaVersion:1 payload (meta + categories). Strips non-contract fields.

nodes.name: Publish to API
nodes.notes: PUT to config.website.publishUrl with Bearer PUBLISH_API_KEY. Retries 5xx/timeouts; failed runs do not wipe Railway storage.

nodes.name: Done
nodes.notes: Successful publish path — refresh Vercel site to verify.

nodes.name: Empty Run Guard
nodes.notes: Log empty-run stats. Do not call LLM. Do not overwrite website latest summary.

nodes.name: AI Failed Guard
nodes.notes: No grounded category bullets. Do not overwrite website latest summary.
